newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyu Department shares down on report.
newsitem.headline: Tokyu Department shares down on report.

text.p: Shares in Tokyu Department Store Co Ltd, a leader of the Tokyu group's retail and distribution division, slipped on Friday morning, due to a newspaper report which said the firm and Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd were involved in an irregular securities deal.

Tokyu Department Store was not immediately available for comment on the report in the Sankei Shimbun newspaper. Yamaichi said it could not confirm whether it had made such a deal, and added it could not comment further.
At 0123 GMT, Tokyu Department Store was down 14 yen at 434, having been ask-only at the opening. Volume was 475,000 shares.
